papers.title_en: Write Once, Query Many: Evolving Compact Reusable Memory for Long Videos
papers.authors: Kerui Chen, Jinglu Wang, Yun Wang, Xinjiang Wang, Yan Lu
papers.evidence: 基于时间锚定观测的可复用紧凑视频记忆，保留时序导航能力
papers.tldr: 长视频超出多模态大模型上下文，且逐查询智能体检索会重复视频处理与证据定位。Video-EMem 以时间锚定观测构建可复用记忆，融合紧凑自由文本与稀疏图像，Writer 一次编码，Reader 仅从记忆检索证据。冻结底层模型，分别用源保真覆盖和问答失败反馈演化工作流，平均准确率较未演化提升 7.2%。存储较原始视频降约 99.86%，并在三个长视频问答基准上优于直接输入 2048 帧，实现写一次、多次查询。
papers.abstract_en: Long videos often exceed the context capacity of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), while agentic search repeats costly video processing and grounding for each query. Reusable memory can amortize this cost, but must preserve information for questions unknown during construction. We propose Video-EMem, an evolvable video memory harness built on time-anchored perceptual observations. This representation combines compact free-form text with sparse images to preserve semantic content and complementary visual details across temporal scales, supporting temporal navigation without a fixed semantic schema. A Writer encodes each video once by consolidating overlapping multiscale observations, and a Reader retrieves and organizes evidence solely from the resulting memory. With the underlying models frozen, we evolve their workflows and operators using distinct feedback: query-independent source fidelity and coverage for the Writer, and QA failures in evidence localization and utilization for the Reader. Experiments support this separation for generalization beyond development queries, with our evolution strategy improving average accuracy by 7.2% over the unevolved harness. While reducing storage by about 99.86% on average relative to raw videos, Video-EMem improves Qwen3-VL-30B by an average of 2.6% across three long-video QA benchmarks over direct input of 2,048 frames. Using the same o3 answer model as the state-of-the-art agentic method, it improves average accuracy by 2.5% with lower per-query latency.

papers.title_en: Right On Q: Recovering Reasoning under Quantization via Self-Generated Trajectories
papers.authors: Boyuan Zheng, Jing Xiong, Chenwei Wu, Hui Shen, Zesen Zhao, Hei Ting Una Chan, Xueshen Liu, Zhen Zhang, Liyue Shen, Zechun Liu, Z. Morley Mao
papers.evidence: 量化感知训练恢复低比特大模型推理能力
papers.tldr: 低比特量化大模型在长程推理上仍易失准且难以在预算内终止，现有QAT用固定响应序列监督，导致训练前缀与学生生成轨迹错配。OnQ从块级校准出发，让学生基于自生成轨迹接受全精度教师指导，并用候选级Dynamic KL平衡欠预测与过预测。在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B的2/3比特设置下，OnQ取得九基准最高均值；2比特时各模型各基准全面领先，Qwen3-8B均值较最强基线提升10.26分。该方法还缩短响应并减少截断与重复错误。
papers.abstract_en: Quantization-aware training (QAT) aims to recover reasoning capabilities in low-bit large language models (LLMs). Existing recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the original full-precision model on fixed response sequences. However, the resulting low-bit quantized models still struggle on long-horizon reasoning tasks and often fail to terminate within a token budget that suffices for the full-precision model. We identify two challenges in closing this gap. First, fixed-response supervision leaves a mismatch between training prefixes and those encountered during student generation, and this trajectory divergence grows as responses lengthen. Second, on its own prefixes, the student underpredicts some next-token candidates and overpredicts others, and this distributional misalignment becomes more frequent at high-entropy prefixes. We present OnQ, a low-bit recovery pipeline that combines on-policy distillation and candidate-wise Dynamic KL. Starting from block-wise calibration, the quantized student generates responses and receives full-precision teacher supervision on its own prefixes. Dynamic KL weights forward and reverse KL by each candidate's teacher-student probability ratio to balance correction of under- and overprediction. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B at 2- and 3-bit precision, OnQ achieves the highest nine-benchmark average, with the largest gains on long-horizon reasoning benchmarks. At 2 bits, it outperforms every baseline on every benchmark at every model size, improving the Qwen3-8B average by 10.26 points over the strongest baseline. It also produces shorter responses with fewer truncations and repetitive errors.

papers.title_en: Visual Cache Reuse for Efficient Multimodal Inference
papers.authors: Shuheng Gao, Yuankai Fan, Jiaqiang Ma, Jiawei Shao, Yongkun Li, Xuelong Li
papers.evidence: 视觉语言模型效率中的视觉令牌选择与缓存复用
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型处理大图时视觉token序列长，预填充延迟和显存开销高；现有系统多用精确缓存复用，忽略近似缓存潜力。VisMemo通过熵感知KV cache复用与差异化缓存管理，在近似命中时选择性重算并优化跨GPU/CPU/SSD的I/O。实验保持输出质量，真实trace缓存命中率从27.78%升至61.45%，8K输入预填充延迟最多降48.3%。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language model (VLM) inference incurs substantial prefill latency and memory overhead due to the long visual token sequences of large visual inputs. Existing serving systems typically exploit exact cache reuse through prefix caching or position-independent caching, overlooking the potential of approximate caching in real-world workloads. However, directly reusing an approximate cache entry may introduce spurious visual information, which naive approaches that select a subset of important visual tokens for recomputation fail to adequately mitigate this risk.   We present VisMemo, an efficient serving system that enables approximate KV cache reuse for modern VLMs. Its core is a system-algorithm co-design that combines an entropy-aware KV cache reuse algorithm with differentiated cache management. Specifically, VisMemo uses patch entropy to identify reuse candidates and warmup attention to prioritize recomputation based on the current query. To support the large cache capacity across GPU memory, CPU memory, and SSD storage, VisMemo applies distinct I/O and cache policies to exact and approximate hits: sparse patch-level I/O for approximate hits, prioritized retention for exact hits, and a reserved CPU victim cache for preset entries selected using offline workload priors and online reuse observations. VisMemo further optimizes the memory access path between the inference engine and the storage backend, eliminating redundant caching and unnecessary data movement. Experiments on multiple public datasets show that VisMemo preserves output quality under approximate reuse. On a real-world production trace, VisMemo increases the overall cache hit rate from 27.78% to 61.45% and reduces prefill latency by up to 48.3% at 8K input tokens.

papers.title_en: From Label Priors to Task Evidence: Efficient Long-Video Frame Selection via Bayesian GRPO
papers.authors: Shuochen Chang, Bingjie Gao, Qingyang Liu, Qianli Ma, Yibo Miao, Haonan Zhao, Zhaohe Liao, Xiaofeng Zhang, Jiangtong Li, Li Niu
papers.evidence: 面向多模态大模型的高效长视频帧选择
papers.tldr: 长视频理解受MLLM二次注意力与上下文窗口限制，现有检索式帧选择依赖静态关键帧标注，易与下游推理需求错位。本文把帧选择重构为隐变量推断，先用监督学习初始化轻量策略，再以冻结MLLM为任务环境，用答案似然作为密集任务证据并通过贝叶斯GRPO优化策略。在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上，该选择器以轻量推理效率取得与MLLM评分器相当的准确率。其一次训练可迁移多个下游MLLM，推动帧选择从标签先验转向任务证据。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face significant scalability challenges in long-video understanding due to quadratic attention complexity and context window constraints. Existing retrieval-based approaches typically rely on supervised learning from static keyframe annotations. However, these label priors often fail to align with the actual information required by downstream MLLMs for complex reasoning, creating a misalignment between the training target and inference needs. To bridge this gap, we propose a probabilistic framework that reformulates frame selection as latent-variable inference. We first initialize a lightweight policy using supervised learning to capture general visual saliency. Then, we treat a frozen MLLM as a task environment and use its answer likelihood as dense task evidence to refine the policy via Bayesian Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Within this formulation, the negative log-likelihood (NLL) over ground-truth answer tokens provides a principled dense reward, while a prior-matching KL term preserves semantic consistency with the elicited label prior. This process transitions the selection principle from static label priors to task evidence. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench demonstrate that our selector achieves competitive accuracy with MLLM-based scorers while retaining the inference efficiency of lightweight methods. The selector is trained once with a frozen MLLM environment and transfers directly to multiple downstream MLLMs without retraining. Code is available at \url{github.com/Miraclecsc/Frame_Selection_GRPO}.

papers.title_en: When PTQ Calibration Helps or Hurts: Dose-Driven Collapse and Validation-Gated Abstention in Quantized Text Embedders
papers.authors: Hyojung Han, Ryangkyung Kang, Youngeun Kim, Seung-Hun Jeon
papers.evidence: 分析后训练量化校准剂量对量化文本嵌入模型的影响
papers.tldr: 针对文本嵌入器的学习式PTQ校准，论文区分“校准多远”和“是否校准”：以功能位移D_func度量更新剂量，在e5、BGE-M3与EmbeddingGemma的4比特量化上做161次校准。结果显示同一流程可从增益到灾难性崩溃，崩溃由校准剂量驱动而非检索监督；等剂量不同路径仍有差异。作者将校准视为可选干预，提出验证门控弃权规则，仅在配对置信区间超过未校准基线时接受检查点，在30次决策中无有害选择并保留多数有益更新，但存在安全与机会的权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Learned post-training quantization (PTQ) calibration fits quantizer parameters on a small calibration set, and for a text embedder the natural supervision is retrieval relevance. We ask two questions that are usually conflated: how far to calibrate, and whether to calibrate at all. Across three embedders (e5-base-v2, BGE-M3, EmbeddingGemma-300m) at 4-bit weight quantization, 161 calibration runs, the outcome of a fixed procedure ranges from a gain to catastrophic degradation, and the driver is the dose of the update, measured as the functional displacement D_func of the quantized model from its uncalibrated start. On EmbeddingGemma the same learning-rate grid gives +1.47 to -71.53 points of in-domain NDCG@10 change; a label-free cosine objective collapses at the same dose (-69.52 vs -71.63), so the collapse is a property of learnable calibration rather than of retrieval supervision. Objective sensitivity is heterogeneous: on e5, ranking calibration is substantially more robust than cosine at matched displacement (+14.16 +/- 4.34 pp, 95% t-CI [+3.37, +24.96], three paired slates), whereas on BGE-M3 the ordering is directionally opposite but unresolved ([-5.18, +2.38]). Dose is the main axis but not a sufficient statistic: equal D_func reached along different paths differs by up to 1.61 pp. We therefore treat calibration as an optional intervention. A pre-registered rule that accepts a checkpoint only when a per-query paired confidence interval on a 25% calibration-validation split clears the uncalibrated baseline was run on 6 independent slates and five arms. It never selected a checkpoint below its slate's baseline (0 harmful selections in 30 decisions), retained 8 of 11 beneficial updates, and paid a mean oracle regret of 1.52 pp with one abstention that forfeited 11.13 pp, a safety-opportunity trade-off, not a free improvement. We report what remains open, including label efficiency.

papers.title_en: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
papers.authors: Sebastian Loeschcke, Ivan Koryakovskiy, Tycho F. A. van der Ouderaa, Riccardo Del Chiaro, Mart van Baalen, Paul N. Whatmough, Markus Nagel
papers.evidence: 面向低比特大语言模型的格向量量化感知训练
papers.tldr: 低比特大语言模型的格向量量化具有良好率失真权衡，但其量化感知训练行为与优化机制仍缺乏理解。SQuAT将权重分解为方向与增益，方向用E8派生球面码本量化、增益用低比特标量量化，并对二者分别采用独立直通估计器。它还通过分布式精确最近邻分配把VQ-QAT训练加速12.8倍并扩展到100亿token规模。在多个LLaMA与Qwen模型上，SQuAT在相同量化器与初始化下稳定优于标准STE，取得当前最优的VQ-QAT精度。
papers.abstract_en: Vector quantization (VQ), in particular lattice-based methods, offer strong rate-distortion trade-offs for low-bit large language models (LLMs), yet their behavior under quantization-aware training (VQ-QAT) remains poorly understood. We scale lattice VQ-QAT to billion-parameter LLMs and multi-billion-token training regimes, and introduce SQuAT, a shape-gain VQ-QAT approach trained with a separate straight-through estimator (STE) for the shape and gain. SQuAT decomposes weights into direction and magnitude: normalized directions are quantized using an $E_8$-derived spherical codebook, while gains are quantized independently with low-bit scalar quantizers. We show that, unlike a standard STE applied to the full quantizer, which ignores the shape-gain structure, these separate STEs induce tangent-space updates for directions, yielding an implicit form of spherical (Riemannian) optimization. To enable scalability, we develop a distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment scheme, in which workers quantize disjoint weight blocks and communicate only discrete indices, reducing VQ-QAT training time by 12.8$\times$ and allowing us to scale it to 10B tokens. Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE under identical quantizers and initialization, and achieves SOTA VQ-QAT accuracy.

papers.title_en: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
papers.authors: Sihan Yang, Jie Huang, Hanxuan Li, Yifan Guo, Weigao Sun, Yiran Zhong, Weiyang Liu
papers.evidence: 通用序列压缩器，用于多模态模型的视觉token压缩
papers.tldr: 序列压缩是高效语言与多模态模型的关键信息瓶颈，但池化或学习投影等主流方法仍表现不足。作者从测试时回归视角重思压缩：输入 token 定义回归问题，拟合系数即压缩表示，且回归目标端到端学习、系数在前向中闭式求解，形成 TTR-Compressor。在块稀疏注意力中，它显著提升 RULER 并大幅优于注意力压缩器；在视觉 token 合并中，以少 55.6% 的视觉 token 匹配标准 MLP 合并器。该工作将测试时回归确立为序列压缩的有效基础算子。
papers.abstract_en: Sequence compression is a fundamental operation and a critical information bottleneck in efficient language and multimodal models, and yet prevailing approaches based on pooling or learned projections remain underperforming. We revisit sequence compression through the lens of test-time regression: input tokens define a regression problem whose fitted coefficients form the compressed representation. Importantly, the regression problem is learned end-to-end via backpropagation, while its coefficients are computed efficiently in closed form during the forward pass. This leads to TTR-Compressor, a general alternative to conventional pooling and projection-based compression. We evaluate TTR-Compressor as the compressor for block-wise sparse attention and the visual token merger for multimodal large language models. On block-wise sparse attention, TTR-Compressor improves RULER performance over attention-based compressors by a large margin. For visual token merging, it consistently outperforms the standard MLP merger and matches its performance with 55.6% fewer visual tokens. These results establish test-time regression as an effective primitive for sequence compression in efficient language and multimodal models.

papers.title_en: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
papers.evidence: n元嵌入表的低精度量化
papers.tldr: n-gram 嵌入表能提升语言模型性能，但内存开销巨大，如 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的 Engram 表占 1960 亿参数。作者系统研究低精度存储与量化方法，在 nanochat、Llama、GPT-2 系列上验证四比特表可节省约 75% 表内存，并保留超过 99% 的验证损失改进。更低位宽会掉点，但短时微调可恢复较多性能；把省下内存用于扩大表还可超过全精度基线。该工作为降低 n-gram 嵌入内存并提升模型性能提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. Using fewer bits leads to a larger drop in performance, although we find that a short fine-tuning phase recovers a significant part of this loss. In addition, reinvesting the saved memory in larger tables can improve performance beyond that of the original full-precision tables while still using less memory. These table memory savings also extend to large existing models: on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory, with perplexity increases of less than 1.2% and largely preserved downstream task performance. These findings establish low-bit precision as a practical way to reduce the memory requirements of n-gram embeddings and use the saved capacity to improve model performance.
